shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright rounded-top slab/monument
justification: Both are upright monuments carved in shallow relief with a disc-like circular element and elements stacked in horizontal zones, but A depicts a legible figural scene of standing human figures with raised arms facing each other beneath a band of script-like signs, while B shows non-figural abstract emblems (paired discs, crescent-like arcs, a V-shaped and rod-like device) with no human bodies or writing. The only correspondences — a disc and vertical zoning — are the kind any tradition could produce independently.
